full_prompt_en: A square illustration shows a pale young woman seated in profile among tall stems of red flowers. Her black hair is arranged in a low, loose knot with a small crimson accent, and she tilts her face upward slightly while resting one hand beneath her chin. A fitted black garment carries intricate brown ornamental patterning down the collar and side panels; the dark lower body forms a strong silhouette against a warm ivory ground. The other hand extends delicately across one bent knee. Thin gray-brown stems rise around her in an irregular lattice, bearing flat scarlet blossoms at the top, sides and near the hem. The plants overlap her clothing without obscuring the pose. Fine controlled ink lines define hair, fingers and embroidery; broad matte black areas give the elaborate detail a quiet center of gravity. Skin remains almost the color of the paper, with restrained blush at the lips and cheeks. Vertical panel seams and faint surface grain make the background feel like an aged decorative print. The image is both intimate and formal, with ample pale space around the upper figure and dense motifs lower down. Red accents are few but decisive. The mood is elegant and slightly somber, built from the tension between delicate linework, stillness and the stark black-red-ivory palette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅正方形插画呈现一位肤色苍白的年轻女子侧身坐在高高的红花茎之间。黑发松松挽成低髻，缀着一点绯红；她微微仰脸，一只手托在下巴下。贴身黑衣在衣领与侧边饰有繁密褐色纹样，下身深色形块在暖象牙色底上形成有力剪影。另一只手轻巧地伸过弯曲的膝盖。细灰褐花茎在周围升起成不规则格网，顶部、两侧与衣摆附近长着平涂朱红花朵。植物与衣饰交叠，却没有遮住姿态。精确的细墨线定义发丝、手指和刺绣；宽阔哑黑色块给繁复细节以安静重心。皮肤几乎与纸色相同，唇颊只有克制红晕。竖向屏风接缝和轻微表面颗粒使背景像老装饰版画。画面亲密而正式，上方人物周围留有充足浅色空间，下方纹饰较密。红色点缀不多，却非常果断。气氛优雅且略带忧郁，来自纤细线条、静止姿态和黑红象牙色谱之间的张力。
style_prompt_en: The style is refined decorative ink illustration with broad matte dark silhouettes, delicate controlled contour and sparse saturated red accents. Warm paper color remains open around densely patterned zones. Fine botanical or ornamental line networks weave through larger shapes without destroying the focal hierarchy. Skinlike pale values receive minimal blush, and slight grain evokes an aged print. A poised square composition balances vertical rhythms, intricate surface decoration and generous negative space. The emotional tone is elegant, still and faintly ominous.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格是精致装饰性墨线插画，结合宽阔哑黑剪影、受控细轮廓与少量饱和红色重音。暖纸色在密集图案区周围保持开放。细密的植物性或装饰性线网穿过大形块，却不破坏焦点层次。近肤色的浅明度只带最低限度红晕，轻微颗粒唤起旧印相。端静的正方形构图平衡竖向节奏、繁复表面装饰与宽阔留白。情绪优雅、静止且隐约不祥。
theme_en: A seated woman among red flowers in an ornate ink illustration
theme_zh: 华丽墨线插画中坐于红花之间的女子
name: Takato Yamamoto
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
